faq.title: Everything you need to know about GlassFolio

q1.question: Where is my financial data stored and can anyone read it?
q1.answer: Your sensitive portfolio data (positions, transactions, goals, AI keys) is encrypted directly inside your browser using WebCrypto AES-256-GCM derived via PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 iterations) and HKDF. Neither our static hosting provider nor any third party has access to your master password or unencrypted financial records.

q2.question: Does the French Tax Simulator replace official DGFiP tax filing?
q2.answer: No. GlassFolio provides mathematical simulations comparing the 30% PFU Flat Tax and the Progressive Income Scale (Case 2OP), along with an educational guide to Cerfa 2042, 2074, 2086, and 3916 boxes. It is strictly an informational estimation tool and does not constitute certified tax or AMF investment advice.

q3.question: Which brokers, envelopes, and CSV formats are supported?
q3.answer: GlassFolio natively detects CSV exports from BoursoBank, Trade Republic, Binance, Kraken, Bitget, and Coinbase in both History Mode and Snapshot Mode, and tracks PEA, CTO, Assurance-Vie, Livrets, Crypto wallets, and Real Estate.

q4.question: How do the AI Copilot and MCP Server protect my privacy?
q4.answer: You can run 100% offline with Local Ollama so zero data ever leaves your machine, or connect Claude Desktop / Cursor via the local MCP stdio server. Before any prompt leaves the app, guardrailsService strips secrets, and any state-modifying tool requires explicit human-in-the-loop confirmation.

q5.question: What is the difference between Cloud Mode and Local Docker Mode?
q5.answer: In Cloud mode, GlassFolio serves this interactive public showcase and stores your encrypted vault in your browser's storage. In Local mode (VITE_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=local via Docker), the app skips the marketing landing page and boots directly into your self-hosted authentication vault.

q6.question: How can I try GlassFolio without creating an account?
q6.answer: Click any 'Try Live Demo (1-Click)' button on this page. It immediately unlocks a rich, pre-populated multi-asset demo portfolio (PEA, CTO, Crypto, tax scenarios, and quests) right in your browser.
